title: Eduardo Bolsonaro Lobbies Washington for Sanctions Against Supreme Court Justice Moraes
detail: US sovereignty tensions returned to the center of Lula's re-election campaign as Eduardo Bolsonaro (Jair's son and congressman) actively lobbied Washington to impose new sanctions against Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. The development underscores the ongoing battle between Bolsonarismo and Brazil's judiciary, with the US-Brazil relationship becoming a key electoral flashpoint ahead of the October elections.
